# Native-only wrapper (ESPHome migration transition).
#
# The sources shared by the native ESP-IDF firmware and the ESPHome
# `esp_nest` external component live in a single copy inside the ESPHome
# component directory. This component compiles them into the native build
# and exposes that directory as an include path, so `main/` keeps
# including e.g. "light_sync.h" unchanged.
#
# Shared sources:
#   - light_sync.c: pure-logic light synchronization state machine;
#   - the compiled UI assets: the four page background glows
#     (bg-glow-*.c, generated by tools/gen_glow_assets.py) and the three
#     lv_font_conv fonts (font_*.c, see assets/README.md). `main/ui.c`
#     references them by symbol (LV_IMAGE_DECLARE / LV_FONT_DECLARE).
#
# Sources are listed with SRCS only: IDF ignores SRC_DIRS whenever SRCS is
# given, and the directory also holds ESPHome-only sources that must never
# reach the native build.
#
# The assets include "lvgl.h", so the managed LVGL component (declared in
# main/idf_component.yml) is a private requirement; the public header
# light_sync.h has no LVGL dependency.
#
# Removed together with the native firmware once the migration is done.

set(ESP_NEST_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../esphome/esp-nest-components/esp_nest)

idf_component_register(
    SRCS "${ESP_NEST_DIR}/light_sync.c"
         "${ESP_NEST_DIR}/bg-glow-orange.c"
         "${ESP_NEST_DIR}/bg-glow-purple.c"
         "${ESP_NEST_DIR}/bg-glow-teal.c"
         "${ESP_NEST_DIR}/bg-glow-yellow.c"
         "${ESP_NEST_DIR}/font_cambria_140.c"
         "${ESP_NEST_DIR}/font_helvetica_100.c"
         "${ESP_NEST_DIR}/font_helvetica_140.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "${ESP_NEST_DIR}"
    PRIV_REQUIRES lvgl__lvgl
)
